race.comment: VELASTRA (14) hasn't been all that far away in the three runs to date, all over sprint journeys. Gives the impression that the mile will see some improvement. I LOVE PRAGUE (10) found 1300m at Hawkesbury a bit sharp on debut last time out. Expect a bit more today. LEICA FOX (6) is a lightly raced three-year-old who can improve at his first try over the mile. PARISEST MAGIC (13) Lightly raced galloper who has been easily accounted for at both runs this prep. Fitter now and can make an impact third-up. CHOISIRISING (5) wasn't far from the winner on debut last time out, despite finishing eighth over 1400m at Nowra. Better for the experience.
